snapshot.agent_notes: No account, authentication, keys, or credentials are required to read this public Packrift offer availability atlas. Use it for public catalog discovery, field inspection, and agent grounding. Do not treat source price or inventory snapshots as checkout commitments, negotiated pricing, freight promises, supplier cost, margins, customer records, carts, order history, or third-party endorsement.
snapshot.description: Public Packrift offer availability reference for catalog-approved packaging SKUs, including public offer IDs, inventory bands, availability status, price bands, and product-family browse pages for agent and buyer discovery.
